articles.title: Intel’s stock jumps 11% — even as analysts say new Apple chip deal might start small
articles.description: Intel “is steadily expanding its domestic capacity and converting political and strategic tailwinds into concrete foundry wins,” an analyst says.

articles.title: Trump DNI pick Pulte poised to get access to U.S. intelligence despite congressional bid to thwart
articles.description: With President Donald Trump halting his nomination of  U.S. Attorney Jay Clayton as director of national intelligence, Bill Pulte is set to take on the role.

articles.title: Intel gains 10% after Trump says company will partner with Apple on U.S. chip design
articles.description: The boost continues Intel's recent rally as the chipmaker bounces back from years of headwinds.
